limitations: Network distances are calculated on OSM geometry, not straight lines.
POI-to-network snaps are unverified straight-line associations, excluded from reported walking distance. Routes are candidates, not verified door-to-door directions.
Missing paths and crossings cause disconnected components. No artificial joins are added.
Construction and access tags reflect map observations, not live closure reports. Conditional restrictions are flagged but not evaluated by time.
Wheelchair accessibility is unknown unless independently verified; steps and restricted access are excluded only from their applicable profiles.
Vehicle oneway is ignored for pedestrians; explicit oneway:foot is respected. Turn restriction relations and indoor passage routing are not supported.
